searchText: We haven't had a time to go through https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/321 last call. We're going to get back to this proposal on CL call this week (https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/660#issuecomment-1313920711). Take a look if you have a time, everyone's input is very much appreciated. We didn’t cover this on the last ACD, but would anyone here oppose announcing the deprecation of Ropsten for something like late December? We’ve mentioned in the past a few times it will shut down “by EOY”, and so I think it’d be good to put out another post about this. Again, unless someone sees a strong reason not to. I think the big question is whether it will survive that long. It's already down to 38% validator participation...

excerpts.content:
We didn’t cover this on the last ACD, but would anyone here oppose announcing the deprecation of Ropsten for something like late December? 

We’ve mentioned in the past a few times it will shut down “by EOY”, and so I think it’d be good to put out another post about this. Again, unless someone sees a strong reason not to.
